+from fastapi import FastAPI, Depends, Security
+from fastapi.security import OAuth2PasswordBearer
+from fastapi.openapi.utils import get_openapi
+import json
+
+app = FastAPI()
+oauth2_scheme = OAuth2PasswordBearer(tokenUrl="token")
+
+async def dep_with_scopes(token: str = Security(oauth2_scheme, scopes=["scope1"])):
+    return token
+
+async def dep_without_scopes(token: str = Security(oauth2_scheme), 
+                            parent: str = Depends(dep_with_scopes)):
+    return token
+
+@app.get("/op1", dependencies=[Depends(dep_without_scopes)])
+async def op1():
+    return {"message": "op1"}
+
+@app.get("/op2", dependencies=[Depends(oauth2_scheme)])
+async def op2():
+    return {"message": "op2"}
+
+openapi_schema = get_openapi(
+    title="Test",
+    version="1.0.0",
+    routes=app.routes,
+)
+print(json.dumps(openapi_schema, indent=2))
